Medium-wide over-the-shoulder shot on a 35mm lens, handheld perspective, with Scarlett (Image 1) standing at the right third of a compact downtown apartment bathroom vanity, one hand gripping a sealed coral lipstick carton and the other poised to tear it open, weight shifted toward the black stone sink and eyes fixed on the carton. A smartphone rests beside the chrome faucet in the near foreground, visibly vibrating but ignored. White glossy wall tile and the mirror fill the background, leaving open space toward the sink for the ritual. Hard directional morning sunlight cuts a crisp stripe across tile and basin while the rest stays softly neutral. Modern social-first beauty product photography, tactile editorial energy, clean bright true-to-life color, 16:9.
